text: At its meeting of February 26, 2019, City Council approved an exemption for the implementation of permit parking on Castleton Avenue, between Henrietta Street and Corbett Avenue from the requirements of subsection 925-4B of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 925, Permit Parking. City Council Decision http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2019.EY3.26 Subsection 925-4B, provides that: Where permit parking is not currently available and where a petition requesting permit parking signed by the residents of a minimum of 25% of the total number of residential premises having a residential address on the street or the flank of the street is submitted to the General Manager, a poll shall be conducted in accordance with Chapter 190, Polling and Notification, to determine if the residents wish to have permit parking on their road or area, as the case may be. In the event…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Amended Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate Castleton Avenue, between Henrietta Street and Corbett Avenue, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week.
